blocks.text: STUDY / LIVING THE CHRISTIAN LIFE / HYMNS
When slumber seals our weary eyes On dreaming
John Newton printed it in 1779 in Olney Hymns, Book II, no. 98, under Isaiah 29:8.
Isaiah 29:8 the verse printed above it
The words as Newton printed them, 32 lines.
Newton printed the hymn under Isaiah 29:8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

as when a hungry man dreams he is eating, then awakens still hungry; as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking, then awakens faint and parched. So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion. ISAIAH 29:8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ISAIAH 29
What schemes we form, what pains we take! We fight, we run, we fly, we fall; But all is ended when we wake, We scarcely then a trace recall. STANZA IV
Book II of the hymn book, “On occasional subjects”, holds these hymns in this order: 100 hymns. This is number 98. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
